user.title: Connect to the inverter
user.description: Enter the IP address of the inverter's web interface.

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.100. Only plain HTTP is supported.
The new IP address of the same inverter.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the inverter. If it is dark outside it has probably powered down; try again in daylight.
error.invalid_device: That address answered but returned no readable serial number, so it does not look like a Solar Frontier inverter.

abort.wrong_inverter: That address belongs to a different inverter than the one being reconfigured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read live measurements and operating state. The inverter is slow and handles one request at a time, so 30 seconds is recommended.
